permissions.name: dsh-cursor-maker.process.spawn
permissions.reason: Run the bundled Python rasteriser that draws the pointer frames, and the PowerShell helper that writes the cursor scheme into HKCU.

permissions.name: dsh-cursor-maker.fs.write
permissions.reason: Store the generated .cur/.ani files, their previews, and the backup of the previous scheme under the user's local app data.

x-display.title: Cursor Maker
x-display.description: Turns a picture from the chat into a full Windows cursor scheme and swaps the live pointer to it.

x-prompt-sections.name: dsh-cursor-maker:offer
x-prompt-sections.summary: Tells the model that a freshly received picture can become the mouse pointer, that it must ask first, and which tool builds it.

x-tool-namespaces.source: bundled Python rasteriser and PowerShell registry helper
x-tool-namespaces.shellPermission: Runs only after the user agreed to replace their pointer; the host process spawns the bundled Python and a fixed PowerShell script

x-components.presentation: One row with three switches: mount the plugin, offer it after every picture, and override the Python path.
x-components.notes: Cursor schemes are a Windows concept, so the bundle declares win32 and is skipped everywhere else. Generated sets are kept forever and can be re-applied with cursor_apply.
